facts.statement: Two organisations trade as “Oak House” at one shared address but have different payers. Assets OLD-11 and NEW-11 serve the same room; NEW replaced OLD. Archive invoices/certificates refer to OLD. Another roof asset has serial explicitly unknown; neighbouring serial is readable.

Authenticated episode manufacturer notice RN-11 applies to model COOL-11 serials 100–150, requires scope verification and competent interim-risk review. NEW-11 serial 120 is confirmed affected; roof model COOL-11 serial unknown cannot be conclusively excluded. Casey owns verification at 13:00.
